PPE Exported Functions

group PPE_Exported_Functions

Functions

void PPE_Cmd(FunctionalState state)

Enable PPE.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    PPE_Cmd(ENABLE);
}

Parameters:

state -- [in] New state of the PPE peripheral.

  • ENABLE: Enable PPE function.

  • DISABLE: Disable PPE function.

void PPE_Suspend(void)

Suspend PPE.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    PPE_Suspend();
}

void PPE_Resume(void)

Resume PPE.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    PPE_Suspend();
    // some ohter operation
    PPE_Resume();
}

void PPE_Abort(void)

Abort current operation, must invoke after all channels are inactive.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    PPE_Suspend();
    while(PPE_ChannelInactiveCheck());
    PPE_Abort();
}

ITStatus PPE_ChannelInactiveCheck(void)

Check PPE channel status.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    ITStatus res = PPE_ChannelInactiveCheck();
}

Return values:

  • SET -- Channels are not all inactive.

  • RESET -- Channels are all inactive.

Returns:

Channel state.

ITStatus PPE_GetINTStatus(uint32_t PPE_INT)

Check interrupt status.

Example usage

}

Parameters:

PPE_INT -- [in] Specified PPE interrupt from PPE Interrupt

Return values:

  • SET -- Interrupt has been triggered.

  • RESET -- Interrupt has not been triggered yet.

Returns:

Interrupt status.

void PPE_MaskINTConfig(uint32_t PPE_INT_MSK, FunctionalState NewState)

Mask specified interrupt.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    PPE_MaskINTConfig(PPE_SUSP_INAC_INT, ENABLE);
}

Parameters:

  • PPE_INT -- [in] Specified PPE interrupt from PPE Interrupt

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the PPE interrupt mask

    • ENABLE: Mask specified interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Unmask specified interrupt.

PPE_ERR PPE_Scale(ppe_buffer_t *image, ppe_buffer_t *buffer, float x_ratio, float y_ratio)

Scale the input image and save the result in output image buffer.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t image, buffer;
    image.width = 25;
    image.height = 25;
    image.format = PPE_RGB888;
    image.memory = (uint32_t*)SOURCE_PIC_1;
    image.address = (uint32_t)image.memory;

    buffer.format = PPE_RGB565;
    buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.address = (uint32_t)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    memset(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER, 0, sizeof(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER));
    PPE_ERR err = PPE_Scale(&image, &buffer, 3, 0.8);
}

Parameters:

  • image -- [in] Pointer to input image buffer.

  • buffer -- [in] Pointer to output image buffer.

  • x_ratio -- [in] Scale ration on horizontal direction.

  • y_ratio -- [in] Scale ration on vertical direction.

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Scale_Rect(ppe_buffer_t *image, ppe_buffer_t *buffer, float x_ratio, float y_ratio, ppe_rect_t *rect)

Scale a part of input image and save in output image buffer.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t image, buffer;
    image.width = 25;
    image.height = 25;
    image.format = PPE_RGB888;
    image.memory = (uint32_t*)SOURCE_PIC_1;
    image.address = (uint32_t)image.memory;

    buffer.format = PPE_RGB565;
    buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.address = (uint32_t)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    memset(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER, 0, sizeof(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER));
    ppe_rect_t rect = {6, 4, 20, 24};
    PPE_ERR err = PPE_Scale_Rect(&image, &buffer, 3, 3, &rect);
}

Parameters:

  • image -- [in] Pointer to input image buffer.

  • buffer -- [in] Pointer to output image buffer.

  • x_ratio -- [in] Scale ration on horizontal direction.

  • y_ratio -- [in] Scale ration on vertical direction.

  • rect -- [in] Boundary inside the input image.

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result

PPE_ERR PPE_Clear(ppe_buffer_t *buffer, uint32_t color)

Clear the image buffer with certain color in ABGR8888 format.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t buffer;

    buffer.format = PPE_RGB565;
    buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.address = (uint32_t)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.width = 64;
    buffer.height = 64;

    PPE_ERR PPE_Clear(&buffer, 0xFFFF00FF);
}

Parameters:

  • buffer -- [in] Target buffer to be cleared.

  • color -- [in] Specified color in ABGR8888 format PPE_ABGR8888

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Clear_Rect(ppe_buffer_t *buffer, ppe_rect_t *rect, uint32_t color)

Clear a part of buffer with certain color in ABGR8888 format.

Example usage

Return values:

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Blend(ppe_buffer_t *image, ppe_buffer_t *buffer, ppe_translate_t *trans, PPE_BLEND_MODE blend_mode)

Blend source image onto target buffer.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t image, buffer;
    image.width = 25;
    image.height = 25;
    image.format = PPE_RGB888;
    image.memory = (uint32_t*)SOURCE_PIC_1;
    image.address = (uint32_t)image.memory;

    buffer.format = PPE_RGB565;
    buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.address = (uint32_t)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.width = 64;
    buffer.height = 64;
    memset(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER, 0, sizeof(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER));

    ppe_translate_t trans = {20, 20};
    PPE_Blend(&image, &buffer, &trans, PPE_BYPASS_MODE);
}

Parameters:

  • image -- [in] Source image buffer to be blended.

  • buffer -- [in] Target image buffer to be blended onto.

  • trans -- [in] Position information of source image.

  • blend_mode -- [in] Blend mode from PPE Blend Mode to be used.

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Blend_Rect(ppe_buffer_t *image, ppe_buffer_t *buffer, ppe_translate_t *trans, ppe_rect_t *rect, PPE_BLEND_MODE blend_mode)

Blend source image to certain area target buffer.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t image, buffer;
    image.width = 25;
    image.height = 25;
    image.format = PPE_RGB888;
    image.memory = (uint32_t*)SOURCE_PIC_1;
    image.address = (uint32_t)image.memory;

    buffer.format = PPE_RGB565;
    buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.address = (uint32_t)PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER;
    buffer.width = 64;
    buffer.height = 64;
    memset(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER, 0, sizeof(PIC_OUTPUT_LAYER));

    ppe_translate_t trans = {20, 20};
    ppe_rect_t rect = {6, 4, 20, 24};
    PPE_Blend_Rect(&image, &buffer, &trans, &rect, PPE_BYPASS_MODE);
}

Parameters:

  • image -- [in] Source image buffer to be blended.

  • buffer -- [in] Target image buffer to be bleneded onto.

  • trans -- [in] Position information of source image.

  • rect -- [in] Constraint blend area.

  • blend_mode -- [in] Blend mode from PPE Blend Mode to be used.

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Blend_Multi(ppe_input_list_t list)

Blend multiple input layers to output layer.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    ppe_input_list_t list;
    memset(&list, 0, sizeof(list));
    ppe_layer_t layer1, layer2, layer3, layer4, layer0;
    memset(&layer0, 0, sizeof(layer0));
    memset(&layer1, 0, sizeof(layer1));
    memset(&layer2, 0, sizeof(layer2));
    layer0.buffer.address = address0;
    layer0.buffer.color_key_en = DISABLE;
    layer0.buffer.global_alpha_en = DISABLE;
    layer0.buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)address0;
    layer0.buffer.width = 480;
    layer0.buffer.height = 480;
    layer0.buffer.format = PPE_RGB888;
    list.output_layer = &layer0;

    layer1.buffer.address = address1;
    layer1.buffer.color_key_en = DISABLE;
    layer1.buffer.global_alpha_en = DISABLE;
    layer1.buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)address1;
    layer1.buffer.width = 200;
    layer1.buffer.height = 200;
    layer1.buffer.format = PPE_ARGB8888;
    list.input_layer1 = &layer1;
    layer1.trans.x = 139;
    layer1.trans.y = 89;

    layer2.buffer.address = address2;
    layer2.buffer.color_key_en = DISABLE;
    layer2.buffer.global_alpha_en = DISABLE;
    layer2.buffer.memory = (uint32_t*)address2;
    layer2.buffer.width = 200;
    layer2.buffer.height = 200;
    layer2.buffer.format = PPE_ARGB8888;
    list.input_layer2 = &layer2;
    layer2.trans.x = 89;
    layer2.trans.y = 189;

    PPE_ERR err = PPE_Blend_Multi(list);
}

Parameters:

list -- [in] List of layers to be blended.

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.

bool ppe_rect_intersect(ppe_rect_t *result_rect, ppe_rect_t *rect1, ppe_rect_t *rect2)

Get intersected area of 2 rectangle areas.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    if (ppe_rect_intersect(&result, &rect1, &rect2))
    {
        //User operation
    }
}

Parameters:

  • result_rect -- [in] Pointer to rect that stores result

  • rect1 -- [in] Pointer to one rectangle area

  • rect2 -- [in] Pointer to another rectangle area

Return values:

  • true -- rectangle areas have intersection.

  • false -- rectangle areas have no intersection.

Returns:

Operation result.

PPE_ERR PPE_Mask(ppe_buffer_t *src, ppe_buffer_t *target, ppe_rect_t *rect, uint32_t color)

Place mask on target area with specified color.

Example usage 

void test_code(void){
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_PPE, APBPeriph_PPE_CLOCK, ENABLE);
    ppe_buffer_t image, buffer;
    image.width = 25;
    image.height = 25;
    image.format = PPE_RGB888;
    image.memory = (uint32_t*)PSRAM_BUFFER;
    image.address = (uint32_t)image.memory;
    memcpy(&buffer, &image, sizeof(ppe_buffer_t));
    ppe_rect_t rect = {0, 0, 24, 24};
    uint32_t color = 0x80AABBCC;
    PPE_ERR err = PPE_Mask(&image, &buffer, &rect, color);
}

Parameters:

  • src -- [in] Source buffer.

  • target -- [in] Target buffer, can be same with src.

  • rect -- [in] The boundary of the part to be masked.

  • color -- [in] Specified color in ABGR8888 format. PPE_ABGR8888

Return values:

  • PPE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure, cause refers to PPE Error Code .

Returns:

Operation result.
